features:
**Illegal Soccer — Flow release**

__**Soccer**__
```diff
+ Auto Farm: one switch that joins matches, plays, scores, uses items and claims rewards
+ Auto Play: chases the ball, shoots, backs up teammates and plays keeper when you're in goal
+ Goal Aim: every shot goes at the enemy goal (corner or center)
+ Auto Shoot: shoots for you once you're in range, with adjustable range and charge
+ Ball Chase: runs straight to the loose ball or whoever has it
+ Auto Tackle: slide tackles enemy carriers in range
+ Smart Passing: passes to an open teammate when you're trapped and calls for the ball when you're open
+ Dribble Dodge: dodges tackles automatically while you carry the ball
```

__**Items**__
```diff
+ Item Aimbot: items fire at the best target
+ Auto Use Items (beta)
+ Grab Item Boxes (beta)
```

__**Rewards**__
```diff
+ Auto roll with free credits, optional auto keep
+ Roll with coins, with a coin reserve so it never drains you (beta, off by default)
+ Daily reward claim (beta)
+ Auto join match, pick your team
```

__**Movement**__
```diff
+ Speed boost tuned to the game's limits, no more rubber banding
+ Jump boost, infinite jump, fly
+ Ctrl+click move and return point
```

__**Visuals & Server**__
```diff
+ Player ESP and ball ESP
+ Live stats panel: coins, goals, shots, tackles, passes / dodges
+ Anti AFK
+ Auto rejoin after a kick or disconnect, keeps your settings
+ Stuck fix: leaves or rejoins if the farm gets stuck
+ Rejoin and server hop
+ Mobile menu button
```
